course.title: Transportation Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: It is observed that on an average a vehicle driver drives 5000 km during the (10) course of a year. The probability of having an accident is 100 per 200 million vehicle-kilometres. What is the probability of a driver having at least 2 accidents during his driving career extending to 25 years?
